title: Mean sign across clones
statement: Let $E$ be a weighted constraint experiment, let $M$ be a natural number, let an assignment give a sign to each pair of a variable in $V$ and a clone label in $\text{Fin}(M)$, and fix a variable $v\in V$. The clone mean at $v$ is the average numerical value of the signs assigned to $(v,j)$ as $j$ ranges uniformly over $\text{Fin}(M)$.
hypotheses_covered: An assignment from $V\times\text{Fin}(M)$ to the sign set
caveat: The payload does not include the definition of the sign set's numerical value.
